caban_poet.text: Welcome to the caban. That is the hut where quarrymen ate lunch.
It was a school, a debating chamber and a poetry club in one. They argued about politics and verse in equal measure.
A good caban had a stove, a bench and a bard. Mine is the bard. I only need the stove.

then.text: Another flask? No, no, I have to keep one for the poem. Off you go.

else.text: Here, a flask for the road. Hot and sweet. Do not tell the overseer.
